cv.text:
# Jane Doe

**Phone:** +45 00 00 00 00 | **Email:** jane.doe@example.com | **Web:** janedoe.example.com | **Location:** Copenhagen

## Profile

Financial controller with a strong background in group reporting, budgeting and process improvement across retail and banking.

## Work Experience

### Senior Financial Controller | Acme Corp — 2021 - present

- Built the group controlling function from scratch and defined the monthly reporting calendar.
- Cut the month-end close from ten working days to five by standardising reconciliations.
- Mentored two junior controllers and the finance trainees.
- Partnered with sales and operations leaders on budgets, forecasts and pricing decisions.

### Financial Controller | Big Bank — 2018 - 2021

- Owned the IFRS reporting for three Nordic subsidiaries and the yearly external audit.
- Introduced a rolling forecast that replaced the annual budget for the retail division.
- Led the finance workstream of a core-system migration for a team of five.

### Accountant | Example Retail — 2015 - 2018

- Ran accounts payable and receivable for 40 stores.
- Built monthly store KPI reports for regional managers.

## Education

### MSc in Business Economics and Auditing | Copenhagen Business School — 2015

Thesis on revenue recognition under IFRS 15 (with distinction)

### BSc in Business Administration | Aarhus University — 2013

Accounting and finance

## Skills

IFRS and Danish GAAP, group consolidation, budgeting and forecasting, SAP S/4HANA, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Excel (advanced), Power BI, internal controls, stakeholder management.

## Certifications

- **Certified Management Accountant (CMA)** — 2019
- **SAP S/4HANA Finance** — 2022

## Languages

- **English** — fluent
- **Danish** — conversational

greenhouse.demo-3.title: Group Controller
greenhouse.demo-3.score_reason: Group reporting across subsidiaries matches the consolidation work in the CV.
greenhouse.demo-3.description:
Globex Energy is looking for a Group Controller to own the monthly close, reporting and the budget cycle.

You will work closely with the business on forecasts and investment cases, keep the numbers in line with IFRS and our group policies, and improve how we report. You report to the CFO and travel to our sites a few times a year.

We offer a hybrid workplace, a pension scheme and a team that likes clean numbers.

About the role

As our Group Controller you join a finance team of twelve and report to the CFO. You take over a close that runs in eight working days today, and we would like it to run in five by the end of next year. You will be the person the business partners, the auditors and the management team come to with questions about the numbers, and you will have the room to change how we work where it makes sense.

Your responsibilities

- Own the monthly, quarterly and year-end close, including the group consolidation and the eliminations
- Prepare the management reporting pack and present it to the management team every month
- Lead the budget and forecast cycle together with the business partners, three times a year
- Keep our accounting policies in line with IFRS and document the judgements behind them
- Be the main contact for the external auditors and drive the year-end audit
- Develop the internal controls, and make sure they are followed in every entity
- Coach two accountants and take part in hiring as the team grows

What you bring

- A master's degree in finance, accounting or economics, or a state-authorised auditor's background
- Five or more years in controlling or audit, some of it in an international group
- A solid grip of IFRS and consolidation; experience with an ERP such as SAP or Dynamics
- Strong Excel, and the curiosity to automate what you do more than twice
- Clear written and spoken English; Danish is an advantage but not a requirement

What we offer

Globex Energy offers a permanent full-time position with a hybrid setup (two days a week from home), a pension scheme from day one, health insurance, a lunch scheme and a yearly budget for courses and certifications. We have a flat organisation where you will see the effect of your work quickly, and colleagues who help each other.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short letter through the link below. We interview on a running basis and close the position when we have found the right person, so do not wait for the deadline. Questions about the role can go to our Head of Finance; we are happy to have a call before you apply.

stories.title: Halved the month-end close at Oceanic Shipping
stories.context: The group close took ten working days, so management saw last month's numbers in the third week; the goal was five working days within two quarters, without more people.
stories.action: Mapped every close task and owner, standardised the reconciliations and agreed cut-off dates with operations.
stories.result: Close down to five working days; audit adjustments fell from 14 to 3 a year.
stories.learning: The gain came from agreeing cut-offs with the teams outside finance.

stories.title: Rebuilt the cash forecast at Acme Foods
stories.context: Treasury worked from a weekly spreadsheet nobody trusted, and the CFO needed a rolling 13-week view.
stories.action: Pulled bank and ledger data into one model and reviewed variances every Monday.
stories.result: Forecast error under 5% within two months.
stories.learning: A weekly review habit mattered more than the model.
